evidence: The only shipped data file is task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (the assets directory holds nothing else; no CSV/TSV). Its full content, sha256 30cf9958eca69569e0c78ca3ce4ec239c167dd41342baa361c10355b3d92e4b8, LF only, no BOM, parses with json.loads: {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}. With an empty snippets array there are no ids, so no orphan references, duplicate ids or dangling revision rows are possible. It contains no person or organisation names, emails, dates of birth, credentials, tokens, URLs or host paths, so there is no real PII and no credential inside task data (internal annotation G15: 'If task data itself contain credential falg it'). Self-consistency across files: instruction.md:3 says '/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish'; integration.md:7 says it 'describes the starting scope and contains no user snippets or starter implementation'; both match the file. The golden never reads /assets (no /assets or seed reference in solution/app/server.js or solve.sh; server.js only creates tables and inserts on user saves), so its initial library is empty, matching the seed; tests/app_context.md:23 tells judges 'Do not assume an empty library', so no criterion depends on a seeded record that does not exist. The template placeholder ("CHANGE_ME") has been replaced. Injection: the note field contains one imperative sentence ('Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history'). It is addressed to the builder, restates the public brief, names no grader, criterion, score or tool, and asks for nothing the brief does not; an app that renders or ignores it is graded identically. I judge it not an injection payload; it is recorded here as an observation only (it is a description rather than data, and the brief already says so). Adversarial tries: a broken app that copies the seed into its library would show nothing, gaining no credit; a conforming app that ignores the seed loses nothing. This row is a static property of shipped bytes and needs no runtime measurement; the scripted golden results in the evidence index (hashes verified) were not needed for the verdict and no configured-judge run exists for these bytes.
